name: Quarterly Planning
description: Produces a personal quarterly plan with 3-5 goals, weekly milestone breakdowns, review checkpoints, and a quarter-end evaluation template. Use when the user wants to plan the next 3 months, set quarterly personal goals, or create a structured 13-week plan for achieving multiple objectives. Do NOT use for business or organizational quarterly planning (use business strategy skills), single-goal planning (use `smart-goal-builder`), or annual planning (use `annual-review` instead).
